## Constraints & Preferences
- Use only canonical repository `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- Do not create repositories, forks, duplicate projects, or temporary branches unless explicitly approved.
- Current required Phase 1 fields: First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Mobile Phone, Email, Password, Confirm Password; Profile Photo optional.
- Required validation/security: email/E.164 phone validation, password strength, duplicate email/phone prevention, secure password hashing, registration rate limiting, authenticated session creation.
- Required integration: Supabase persistence, Members module and Owner Dashboard visibility, Android/iOS/Web parity.
- Required QA: success, duplicate email/phone, invalid email, weak password, missing fields, session persistence, logout/login, password reset, mobile responsiveness.
- Do not expose credentials, OTPs, or test identities.
- Do not report completion without evidence: commit SHA, deployment ID, Render health, SHA parity, test results, and successful-registration screenshot.

- Preserve rate limiting, duplicate prevention, session/auth integration, and secure OTP handling; replace plaintext OTP fallback persistence with hash-only storage.
- Do not claim production completion until GitHub HEAD, Render deployment SHA, `/health`, and `/version` agree.

5. Replace plaintext OTP fallback `code` storage/comparison with cryptographic hash verification, preserving expiration and attempt limits.
6. Add or repair automated tests for all user-listed registration/auth flows and responsive client behavior where test infrastructure supports it.

9. Deploy through the approved canonical Render process; capture deployment ID and deployed commit SHA.
